sources.title: NEXTDC to Join OpenAI in Australia as an Infrastructure Partner (ASX announcement, 5 December 2025)
sources.notes: NEXTDC's own copy of its 1:28 pm ASX announcement of 5 December 2025 (the ASX lists it as 'NEXTDC joins OpenAI for Australia as Infrastructure Partner'). It confirms a Memorandum of Understanding with OpenAI under the OpenAI for Countries program, to collaborate on planning, development and operation of an AI campus at S7, first phase expected in the second half of 2027 subject to approvals. It states no price, contract term, capacity commitment or stake. ARCHIVED 2026-10-22 at data/raw/operators/nextdc/ with a SHA-256 manifest.

sources.title: NEXTDC FY26 Annual Report and Appendix 4E
sources.notes: Lodged with the ASX on 27 August 2026. Shareholder information lists the substantial holders based on ASX lodgements up to 20 August 2026; the list of subsidiaries at 30 June 2026 includes NEXTDC S7 Holdings Pty Ltd, S7 Holdings MidCo and two S7 trusts, all 100% owned. The report does not mention OpenAI. ARCHIVED 2026-10-22 (PDF not committed; text and manifest are).

sources.title: NEXTDC FY26 Results Presentation
sources.notes: S7 Sydney: total power planned about 550 MW, initial capacity 'TBD', status design and town planning; NEXTDC continues to evaluate third-party capital through a joint venture company for S4, S7 and M5. Does not mention OpenAI. ARCHIVED 2026-10-22 (PDF not committed).

sources.title: NEXTDC 1H26 Results Presentation
sources.notes: Half year to 31 December 2025, the half in which the OpenAI memorandum was announced. Says S7 was granted fast-track status under the NSW Investment Delivery Authority, and that Barrenjoey was appointed lead financial adviser for the joint venture funding of S4 and S7. Does not mention OpenAI. ARCHIVED 2026-10-22 (PDF not committed).
